description: Input payload for creating or updating a VeriSimDB octad entity. All modality fields are optional -- only the modalities provided will be populated or updated. Omitted modalities are left unchanged on update, or unpopulated on create.

document.description: Document content to set. Null or omitted to skip.

oneOf.description: Document modality input. Full-text content for indexing and search.

body.description: Document body. Full-text indexed for search.

fields.description: Additional searchable fields beyond title and body (e.g. 'author', 'category').

title.description: Document title. Used for display and search ranking.

graph.description: Graph relationships to create. Null or omitted to skip.

oneOf.description: Graph modality input. Defines outgoing relationships from this entity to other entities.

relationships.description: List of outgoing edges. Each relationship is a (predicate, target_id) pair.

predicate.description: Edge label or relationship type (IRI or plain string, e.g. 'relates_to', 'https://schema.org/knows').

target_id.description: Target entity octad ID or IRI.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata. Not indexed by any specific modality but stored alongside the entity.

provenance.description: Provenance event to record. Null or omitted to skip.

oneOf.description: Provenance modality input. Records a lineage event in the entity's hash chain.

actor.description: Who or what caused this event (user ID, system component, bot name).

source.description: Optional source identifier (URL, file path, upstream entity ID).

semantic.description: Semantic annotations to set. Null or omitted to skip.

oneOf.description: Semantic modality input. Ontological type annotations and property maps.

properties.description: Semantic key-value properties. Keys are property IRIs or plain strings; values are string literals.

spatial.description: Spatial data to set. Null or omitted to skip.

oneOf.description: Spatial modality input. Geospatial coordinates and geometry.

altitude.description: Altitude in metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid. Optional.

geometry_type.description: OGC Simple Features geometry type. Defaults to 'Point' if omitted.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). North is positive.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). East is positive.

properties.description: Arbitrary spatial metadata (address, region, accuracy, etc.).

srid.description: Spatial Reference System Identifier. Defaults to 4326 (WGS84) if omitted.

tensor.description: Tensor data to set. Null or omitted to skip.

oneOf.description: Tensor modality input. Multi-dimensional numeric data with shape metadata.

data.description: Flattened tensor values in row-major order (float64).

shape.description: Tensor dimensions (e.g. [3, 4] for a 3x4 matrix). The product of all values must equal the length of the data array.

vector.description: Vector embedding to set. Null or omitted to skip.

oneOf.description: Vector modality input. Provides a dense embedding for similarity search.

embedding.description: Dense embedding vector (float32 values). Length must match the store's configured vector_dimension.

model.description: Name or identifier of the embedding model used (e.g. 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2'). Optional, for provenance tracking.

title: OctadInput
